title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Broadcom (AVGO) stock drops 5% as a disappointing revenue forecast overshadows its earnings beat.
Markets: 10-year U.S. Treasury yield hits highest level since November 2023 as inflation and debt concerns pressure global borrowing costs.
Markets: Traders pile into an international stock market that just pulled ahead of the Nasdaq as commodities surge.
Companies: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer for one year, fining the team $30 million and forcing the forfeiture of five first-round picks.
Companies: Uber cuts 10% of its workforce and allows about 1% of its employees to continue working remotely to move simpler and faster.
Companies: Microsoft will begin reporting quarterly Azure revenue in dollars for the first time to provide more clarity about its business that competes with AWS.
Macro/Policy: DOJ says states must report undocumented immigrants to DHS or risk losing federal funding for Temporary Assistance and SSI.
Macro/Policy: U.S. Energy Secretary says more than 17 million barrels of oil transited the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, a wartime record.
